captions.detailed: This 3D model features a complete bicycle gravel 1x crankset assembly. It includes a central cylindrical bottom-bracket shell with a ribbed outer sleeve, a common spindle, and two matching dark grey hollow-forged crank arms oriented 180 degrees apart. Attached to the drive-side crank arm is a large, thin 40T oval chainring with a single-speed tooth profile. At the tip of each crank arm, a composite clip-in pedal is mounted on a stub axle, allowing independent rotation relative to the arms, while the entire crank arm and chainring assembly rotates around the central bottom-bracket axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a gravel 1x bicycle crankset assembly using CadQuery. The assembly must feature a central ribbed bottom-bracket shell, a common spindle axle, two opposing hollow-forged crank arms, a large 40T oval chainring on the drive side, and composite clip-in pedals mounted on stub axles at each crank end. Ensure there are revolute joints defined for the spindle rotation relative to the bracket and for each pedal relative to its respective crank arm.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly by defining three main parts: the bottom-bracket shell (fixed base), the rotating spindle/crank-arm/chainring assembly, and the two individual pedals. The bottom bracket is modeled using a combination of concentric cylinders and patterned rectangular ribs. The rotating crank assembly is constructed by lofting or combining cylindrical bosses for the spindle and pedal eyelets with tapered beams for the crank arms, and adding a thin, patterned oval disk for the 40T chainring. The pedals are constructed from extruded boxes with cutouts to represent clip-in mechanisms. Finally, continuous or revolute joints are defined to link the spindle to the bottom bracket, and each pedal to its corresponding crank arm tip.
